description:
An artist designs his own path for success 🎨

In 2017, @souravjvlogs began uploading his art process to YouTube, showing viewers how to realistically draw everything from legendary Bollywood stars to iconic movie characters. In 2020, he took on a challenge to create 365 vlogs in 365 days, giving a unique and personal look into his family life (including their new puppy Oreo) – and was catapulted into the limelight.

Now, Sourav has 42 million subscribers and has achieved a whopping 24 BILLION lifetime views. The secret to his success? He says there is NO secret – just showing his honest family life as it is is what his fans have so strongly connected to. Go behind the scenes of his transformation from artist to daily vlogger to back to being art himself.

Watch and subscribe to Sourav's channel here: @souravjvlogs
